RTS-1K: offline rootless Apptainer release
	

This derived release contains 984 tasks from Recursive Task Synthesis. RTS-1K is the stable project label; the exact size is 984. The tasks are the strict passing subset of a frozen 1,000-task validation cohort. The 16 failures are preserved in manifests/validation-exclusions.jsonl and were not modified or replaced.
All included tasks passed three reference-oracle attempts and three nop negative-control attempts under offline, rootless… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/laion/rts-1k-rootless-apptainer.
